msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia rociera-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a fuchsia flamenca dress with layered ruffled sleeves and a fitted mermaid skirt, with a teal embroidered silk shawl with long fringe and a teal flower in the hair from the reference, walking at a whitewashed patio in the old town of Córdoba, Spain, with blue flower pots on the walls and red geraniums, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia rociera-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a fuchsia flamenca dress with ruffled sleeves and a long ruffled skirt, with a teal embroidered fringed shawl from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
